חשך.definition: to keep back, withhold, refrain, restrain.

זרוע.definition: herb, vegetables (a hapax legomenon in the Bible, occurring Dan. 1:12).

שמש.definition: to serve, attend, minister, wait upon, function, officiate.

הלך.definition: to go, walk, travel, go away, disappear, continue.

בוא.definition: to come, come in, arrive, enter, reach, happen, set (said of the sun).

בא.definition: he who comes. 1 he who arrives.

שוב.definition: to return, turn back, come again, go again.

קום.definition: to stand up, rise, arise, stand.

עבר.definition: to pass, pass over, cross over.

שלח.definition: to send; to stretch out, extend.

קרא.definition: to cry, call, invoke; to invite; to proclaim; to read.

שום.definition: to assess, value, evaluate, estimate, appraise.

בין.definition: to separate, to divide; to distinguish, to understand.

פא.definition: the letter ‘Pe’ of the Heb. alphabet.

יהוה.definition: the proper name of God in the Bible, Tetragrammaton.

תנא.definition: ‘tanna’, i.e. teacher; specifically teacher mentioned in the Mishnah.

גמרא.definition: ‘Gemara’, commentary on the Mishnah (together with which it forms the Talmud).

פשט.definition: to spread, to strip off; to make a dash, make a raid; to stretch out; to make plain, explain.

דרש.definition: to seek, inquire of, study, to expound.

רמז.definition: to wink, beckon, hint, allude, make signs.

עובדא.definition: plene spelling of עֻבֽדָּא, עֻבֽדָּה. See עֻבְדָּא.

ביתא.definition: beta, name of the second letter of the Greek alphabet.

רבא.definition: (f. רַבּֽתָא or רַבָּתִי) large, great, important.

סבב.definition: to turn about, go round, surround.

ספר.definition: to count, number; to recount, tell, narrate.

חזק.definition: to be or grow strong, to hold fast.

כפר.definition: to atone for, make atonement, expiate.

נא.definition: please, I pray, I pray you.

בטח.definition: to trust, rely, depend upon; to be at ease.

רצה.definition: to be pleased with, to be favorable to.

שאול.definition: the underworld, the nether world, the grave.

שאל.definition: to ask, inquire; to entreat, to beg, to borrow.

בקש.definition: to ask, to quest, to search.

אל.definition: denoting motion toward or to, or direction toward, and meaning ‘to, unto, toward, into, at, by’.

את.definition: the mark of the accusative. Usually prefixed only to a definite noun, as in אֶת־הָאִישׁ (= the man).

בג.definition: food (in the phrase פַּת־בַּג, ‘portion of food’, delicacy).

בו.definition: inflected third pers. singular m. of בּֽ◌ ᴵ, meaning ‘in him’, ‘in it’, ‘therein’.

בוז.definition: to despise, mock at, treat with contempt.

בי.definition: house, home (occurring in numerous phrases quoted from Talmud or Midrash, as in בֵּי־כּֽנִשֽׁתָּא, ‘synagogue’; בֵּי־מַסּוּתָא, ‘bath’; בֵּי־רַב, ‘school’; בֵּי־שֻׁתָּפֵי, ‘partnership). Aram., c. st. of בֵּיתָא (= house). See בַּיִת.]

דו.definition: do — a syllable used in solmization to denote the first tone of the diatonic scale.]

דור.definition: to move in a circle, go round, whence ‘to dwell’.

הא.definition: , ‘He’, name of the fifth letter of the Hebrew alphabet.

הד.definition: joyous shout (a hapax legomenon in the Bible, occurring Ezek. 7:7 in the phrase הֵד הָרִים, ‘joyous shout on mountains’).

הו.definition: ah! alas! woe! (in the Bible occurring only Amos 5:16).

זג.definition: skin of the grape (a hapax legomenon in the Bible, occurring in Num. 6:4).

זור.definition: to turn aside, be a stranger.

חב.definition: bosom (a hapax legomenon in the Bible, occurring Job 31:33 in the form חֻבִּי).

חוב.definition: to be guilty, to be legally bound, owe.

חג.definition: (with the def. art. הֶחָג) feast, festival.

חגג.definition: to make a pilgrimage, to celebrate a feast, to dance, to reel, to be giddy.

חוג.definition: to make a circle, move in a circle.

חול.definition: to move in a circle, whirl, dance, to fall, occur.

חיל.definition: to move in a circle, whirl, dance, writhe.

חק.definition: something prescribed, enactment, decree, statute, law, rule.

חקק.definition: to cut in, engrave, inscribe, decree.

טוח.definition: to spread over, besmear, to press plaster, squeeze.

יי.definition: the proper name of God in the Bible, Tetragrammaton.

כס.definition: throne (a hapax legomenon in the Bible, occurring Ex. 17:16).

כר.definition: saddle (a hapax legomenon in the Bible, occurring Gen. 31:34 in the phrase כַּר הַגָּמָל, ‘camel saddle’).

לח.definition: freshness, vigor (a hapax legomenon in the Bible, occurring Deut. 34:7 in the form לֵחֹה, ‘his freshness’).

לט.definition: enchantment, magic (in the Bible occurring only Ex. 7:22; 8:3 and 14, in the pl. form לָטֵיהֶם).

לע.definition: throat (a hapax legomenon in the Bible, occurring Pr. 23:2).

מה.definition: (מָה before א, ר, before ע provided with another vowel than Qamatz, and in pause; מֶה before הָ, חָ and עָ and in some other cases).

מח.definition: marrow (a hapax legomenon in the Bible, occurring Job 21:24).

מס.definition: body of forced laborers, forced service.

מק.definition: rottenness, decay (in the Bible occurring only Is. 3:24 and 5:24).

נוד.definition: to move to and fro, wander.

נה.definition: wailing lamentation (a hapax legomenon in the Bible, occurring Ezek. 7:11).

ני.definition: wailing, lament (a hapax legomenon in the Bible, occurring Ezek. 27:32).

נוע.definition: to wave; to move; to quiver, tremble; to vibrate.

ניר.definition: to break up (land), till for the first time.

סד.definition: stocks for torturing (in the Bible occurring only Job 13:7 and 33:11).

סט.definition: deviation (a hapax legomenon in the Bible, occurring Ps. 101:3 in the pl. and prob. Meaning ‘deviations from the right path’). Also spelled שֵׂט (q.v.). See סוט.

סי.definition: si (music) — the seventh note in solmization.

סס.definition: moth (a hapax legomenon in the Bible, occurring Is. 51:8).

עד.definition: to, unto, up to, even to.

עוש.definition: a base prob. meaning ‘to make haste, hurry’, and related to base חושׁ ᴵ.

פג.definition: early fig (a hapax legomenon in the Bible, occurring Cant. 2:13 in the suffixed form פַּגֶּיהָ).

פוג.definition: to grow numb; to evaporate; to become faint.

פס.definition: occurring only in the phrase כּֽתֹנֶת פַּסִּים (Gen. 37:3, 23 and 32; Sam. II 13:18 and 19), which prob. means ‘tunic composed of variegated stripes’.

פוק.definition: to reel, totter. Related to פקק ᴵᴵ. cp. Aram. פַּקְפּוּתָא (= shaking).

פש.definition: a hapax legomenon in the Bible, occurring Job 35:15, usually rendered by ‘haughtiness’ or ‘folly’.

פת.definition: a hapax legomenon in the Bible, occurring Is. 3:17 in the form פָּתְהֵן, a word of uncertain meaning. It is usually rendered by ‘vulva’. Others see in פָּתֽהֵן a contraction of פּֽאַתֽהֶן (from פֵּאָה) and translate it ‘corner of their head’, i.e. ‘their forehead’.

צחח.definition: to be dazzling, be bright, be clear.

צור.definition: to bind, wrap, tie; to confine in, narrow, compress; to enclose, shut in; to lay siege to, besiege.

קא.definition: (often shortened into the pref. קָ◌) part. use to form the pres. tense, as in קָא מַשְׁמַע לָן (= he teaches us, lets us know), מַאי קָא מַשְׁמַע לָן (= what does he teach us?; What does he let us know?), הָכֵי קָאָמַר (= so he says; this is what he says).

קדד.definition: to bow down, bow one’s head.

קח.definition: (Ezek. 17:5) prob. meaning ‘he took’, and קָחָם (Hos. 11:3), prob. meaning ‘he took them’, are prob. shortened from לָקַח, resp. לְקָחָם (apheresis).

קוט.definition: a secondary form of base קוץ ᴵ.

קט.definition: small (a hapax legomenon in the Bible, occurring Ezek. 16:47 in the phrase כִּמֽעַט קָט, ‘very soon’, ‘in a very little while’).

קלל.definition: to be light, be slight; to be swift; to be lightly esteemed, be despised.

רבב.definition: to be or become many or much, to be or become great.

רדד.definition: to beat down, repel, subdue, flatten.

רה.definition: re — a syllable used in solmization to denote the second tone of the diatonic scale (music).

רי.definition: moisture (a hapax legomenon in the Bible, occurring Job 37:11).

שו.definition: (a hapax legomenon in the Bible, occurring Job 15:31 and prob. meaning ‘equality’).

שוח.definition: to walk, go for a walk.

שח.definition: meditation; talk (a hapax legomenon in the Bible, occurring Amos 4:13 in the form שֵׂחוֹ).

שחח.definition: a secondary form of שׁוח and שׁחה.

שט.definition: deviator, apostate (a hapax legomenon in the Bible, occurring Hos. 5:2 in the pl. and prob. meaning ‘deviators’ or ‘deviations’).

שי.definition: gift, present (in the Bible occurring only Is. 18:7, Ps. 68:30, 76:12).

תור.definition: to spy out, search out, explore.

תש.definition: third person m. perf. from תָּשַׁשׁ.

תת.definition: inf. Qal of נָתַן (= he gave).

אבב.definition: to bring forth shoots, sprout; the coming of spring.

אגב.definition: on the basis of, by way of, on account of.

אהי.definition: meaning ‘where’ (occurring three times in the Bible, Hos. 13:10 and 14).

אחא.definition: oh my brother! (used in the vocative).

איב.definition: to be hostile to, to hate.

בבא.definition: section of a treatise in the Talmud.

בבה.definition: apple of the eye, pupil of the eye.

בגד.definition: to betray, deceive, to act treacherously.

בדא.definition: to invent, to fabricate, to concoct.

בדד.definition: to be alone, be separated, isolated.

בדח.definition: to be happy, gay, jolly, in a good mood.

בהט.definition: alabaster, porphyry (?) (name of a precious stone) (a hapax legomenon in the Bible, occurring Est. 1:6).

בטה.definition: to speak rashly, to utter, to articulate, to pronounce, to express.

גאה.definition: to be proud, to rise up, be high.

גבב.definition: to vault, raise, lift (whence גַּב, גַּבָּה).

גבח.definition: bald on the forehead (a hapax legomenon in the Bible, occurring Lev. 13:4).

גבאי.definition: gabbai, i.e. head or treasurer of a synagogue (lit.: ‘collector of dues’).

גוה.definition: back, body (a hapax legomenon in the Bible, occurring Job 20:25).

גחה.definition: to draw forth (a hapax legomenon in the Bible, occurring Ps. 22:10 in the suff. part. גֹּחִי).

דבב.definition: to move gently, to walk softly; to drip.

דוד.definition: uncle (the brother of one’s father or mother).

דוח.definition: to rinse, cleanse, wash off by rinsing.

דיה.definition: a bird of prey, the kite (in the Bible occurring only Deut. 14:13, Is. 34:15).

דיו.definition: ink (a hapax legomenon in the Bible, occurring Jer. 36:18).

נגד.definition: to rise, be high, be conspicuous.

הדא.definition: this, that, that is what is written.

הוי.definition: which is to say, in other words.

נטה.definition: to stretch out, extend, incline, bend.

וגה.definition: Vega (the brightest star in the constellation Syra).

זדה.definition: (a word occurring in the Siloam Inscription, of unknown origin and uncertain meaning, usually rendered by ‘breach’).

זיג.definition: a kind of a tight-fitting coat.

זיו.definition: brightness, radiance, splendor, glory (occurring in the Bible only as the name of the month Iyyar, זִו, Kin. I 6:1).

חגא.definition: trembling, reeling (a hapax legomenon in the Bible, occurring Is. 19:17).

טיח.definition: coating, plaster (a hapax legomenon in the Bible, occurring Ezek. 13:12).

יגב.definition: to till the ground, cultivate the land.

ידי.definition: handed; used in the compound דּוּ־יָדִי (= both-handed, ambidextrous; lit.: ‘both-handed’).

יוד.definition: ‘yodh’, ‘yod’ — name of the tenth letter of the Hebrew alphabet.

יחד.definition: to be one, to make one, unite.

יטב.definition: to be good, be pleasing (a collateral form of base טוב).
